name: Call of Fire
summary: In the Barrens, an aspiring shaman begins the second trial in the search for communion with fire. Kranal Fiss sends the initiate across the Southfury River to a secluded mountaintop shrine in Durotar, carrying the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame.

sections.title: A Test of Readiness
sections.body: Kranal Fiss entrusts the shaman with the Torch of the Dormant Flame. Raw mystical strength alone cannot meet fire’s demands; the trial calls for temperance, focus, and respect. The torch is both ritual instrument and proof to the shrine’s keeper that the bearer has been judged ready to attempt the trial.

sections.title: The Hidden Peak
sections.body: The shrine lies across the Southfury River, among Durotar’s southern crags. A weathered stone carved with a fire rune marks an obscure path that climbs toward one of the region’s highest peaks. At the summit, the Shrine of the Dormant Flame is watched by Telf Joolam, a troll hermit. He turns away curious travelers and treasure hunters, keeping the sacred brazier from ordinary eyes until a petitioner arrives with the unlit torch.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Torch of the Dormant Flame?
faq.answer: Kranal Fiss gives the unlit torch as a token of intent. It identifies its bearer to Telf Joolam, keeper of the shrine, as a shaman initiate judged ready for the trial.

aliases: who is the troll at the shrine
faq.answer: Telf Joolam is a shamanic hermit of the Horde who watches over the Shrine of the Dormant Flame atop southern Durotar’s peaks. He guards the brazier from those who do not understand or respect the spirits.

faq.q: Where is the hidden path located?
aliases: how to find shrine of the dormant flame
faq.answer: The hidden trail begins in Durotar, south of the bridge over the Southfury River. Near the riverbank, where the mountains meet the coastline, a standing stone marked with a flame rune signals the narrow ascent up the high ridge.

faq.q: Why must the torch be brought unlit?
faq.answer: The torch is brought unlit because fire must be awakened and mastered through ritual, not simply claimed. Its dormant flame marks the state the shaman must kindle through communion.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Telf Joolam?
faq.answer: After Telf Joolam verifies the torch, he directs the initiate to harsher, more dangerous rites to kindle its dormant flame and prove mastery of elemental fire.

faq.q: Why is this shrine kept secret from the rest of the Horde?
faq.answer: The shrine is kept apart because elemental forces are volatile and dangerous in untrained hands. Shamanic traditions place sacred sites away from everyday settlements, so the curious and treasure hunters do not disturb resting spirits or invite calamity.

angles.text: As a shaman, you seek the Fire Totem by communing with Kalimdor’s elemental forces. That path takes you to remote shrines, beyond simple instruction.
As a member of the Horde, you share shamanic teachings with orcs, tauren, and trolls. Those traditions send disciples from the Barrens’ plains to Durotar’s sacred cliffs.
